description: Find paid x402 data services AI agents can buy, inside one category, ranked. Use before paying any seller.

category.description: category slug or its name in any of 19 languages, e.g. crypto-prices, 加密货币价格, 暗号資産の価格, cotización cripto (see list_categories)

min_accuracy.description: keep sellers whose 95% range of correct paid answers starts at or above this share (0 to 1)

q.description: text to match in name or address

sort.description: accuracy ranks by the low end of the 95% range of paid answers judged correct

tools_honoured.description: AI chat sellers only: keep those whose checked calls passed an agent's tools to the model and never dropped them

name: search_sellers
